title: Great App, Needs better widget
body: Google calendar is a great app to organize the day by events, tasks and reminders. However, the widgets are small and can’t show many events/tasks at the same time. It would be nice if a bigger widget is included as an option.
author: shirineea

title: Suggestions to improve the app
body: Would’ve been better if I could just add pictures other than pdf files to events , also just move events around .Other than that this is the best calendar out there  that really helps with organizing/planning projects and events. :’))
author: Yasmine.25

title: Great app ugly new update
body: I use google calendar app as my main calendar on my iPhone I love the colors, user interface and organization features of it. YET the new updated design rolled out in Dec 2018 is horrible looking on the monthly view (which is my preferred default view). It looks weird, I can’t really put my finger on the change that make it ugly but the design was much much better before! Please bring it back
author: Lama Hachem

title: An essential
body: I use google calendar frequently. It’s a really easy way to organise my schedule. Simple and useful with a nice design.
author: RIO.BD
